01-hook: This whole video was made by talking to Claude.
02-brief: You say what it's about and who it's for. Claude writes the script, and checks it with you first.
03-voice: Then it makes the voiceover. You listen, and pick the takes you like.
04-build: It builds every scene in your colours, your font and your logo, timed to the words.
05-fix: Don't like something? Just say so, and it changes it.
06-close: Then you share it. Your first one takes an afternoon.
